verdict.rationale: Warp documents an API/CLI/SDK/MCP platform with a published OpenAPI spec. The Oz CLI can run and manage cloud agents, connect MCP servers, configure integrations and authenticate headlessly via API keys without the desktop app. A new settings file gives programmatic control over settings. That programmatic surface centers on agents and settings rather than full UI parity. Missing for 10: evidence of API coverage for terminal/UI features (sessions, blocks, Warp Drive management, admin panel controls), an explicit parity statement or coverage reference, and independent hands-on corroboration.
